_rules.field_tilt_with_lead: The side with the territory was chasing the game against a deep block, so territory alone overstates its control; the sentence now says how few passes reached the box.
_rules.shot_spam: Most of those shots were low-quality attempts, so the xG total says more about volume than about danger; the sentence now gives the shot count and the xG per shot.
_rules.small_sample_xg: Too few shots for an xG figure to mean much on its own; the sentence now gives the shot count.
_rules.set_piece_inflation: Most of the chances came from set pieces, so the total overstates open-play creativity; the sentence now splits the two.
_rules.wide_forward_passes: Many forward passes, but mostly wide and rarely into dangerous central areas; the sentence now gives the pass quality.
_rules.ppda_alone: PPDA alone can rank a passive side level with a pressing one in this data; the sentence now adds press intensity.
_rules.causal_claim: Event data shows what happened, not why, so a claim that one thing caused another is never published.
_rules.causal_red_card: A red card cannot be shown to have caused a result from event data, so the claim is never published.
_rules.single_match_fatigue: There is no tracking data, and one match is too small a sample to diagnose fatigue, so the claim is never published.
_rules.ctx_attack_side_vs_finish_side: The lane share pointed to one side, but after switches of play most shots came from the other, so the sentence now says where the shots were taken.
_rules.ctx_crosses_vs_cutbacks: Crosses were many, but cut-backs from the goal line produced the better shots, so the sentence now sets the two side by side.
_rules.ctx_volume_without_central_access: Much of the final-third volume was played along one touchline, so the sentence now gives those spells and the box entries.
_rules.ctx_tilt_without_access: The territory came against a deep block that conceded shots from outside the box, so the sentence now says where the shots came from.
_rules.ctx_losses_vs_immediate_regain: Many of those losses were won back within seconds, so the sentence now gives the regains beside the losses.
_rules.ctx_dominance_with_transition_exposure: The side with the territory also conceded shots on the counter, so the sentence now gives those shots beside the territory.
_rules.ctx_low_volume_high_quality: Few touches, but unpressured shots: a quiet-game claim would mislead, so it is not published.
_rules.ctx_fouls_clustered_after_losses: Many of the fouls came straight after losing the ball in midfield, so the sentence now gives that count beside the total.
_rules.ctx_xg_from_set_pieces: Most of the non-penalty xG came from set pieces, so the sentence now says how much of the total they made up.
_rules.ctx_low_possession_with_direct_threat: Little of the ball, but shots came within seconds of winning it back in their own half, so the sentence now gives those shots.
_rules.ctx_completion_without_pressure_split: One completion figure hid how this player kept the ball under pressure compared with team-mates, so the sentence now gives the split.
_rules.ctx_press_without_secure_build_up: The press was high, but under pressure near their own goal few passes arrived, so the sentence now gives that completion beside the press.
